items.jobDescription:
We are looking for a Power Electronics Engineer to take a leading role in the design, development, and validation of high-voltage and medium-voltage power converter systems. The Medium Voltage Power Electronics Engineer will contribute to advanced R&D activities focused on modular and multilevel converter technologies, supporting the development of high-performance, reliable power conversion solutions for applications such as grid-connected systems, energy conversion, and industrial power electronics. 
 Your Responsibilities
 Take ownership of power converter designs, from the initial concept to detailed design, prototyping and validation
 Design, model and analyse high- and medium-voltage power converters, including modular multilevel converters and other multilevel topologies
 Select suitable converter topologies, semiconductor devices and passive components based on performance, efficiency and reliability requirements
 Develop detailed electrical and thermal models of power electronic systems
 Conduct system-level simulations to analyse the behaviour of converters under different operating and fault conditions
 Support the design and implementation of control and modulation strategies for multilevel converters
 Contribute to the development of firmware and digital control, with experience of DSPs and FPGAs being advantageous
 Support the construction, integration and commissioning of laboratory prototypes and R&D test setups
 Plan and conduct experimental testing, including voltage and current measurements, efficiency evaluations and performance validations
 Analyse the results of experiments and correlate measurements with simulation models
 Prepare technical documentation, design reports and test summaries
 Work closely with mechanical, control and systems engineers on multidisciplinary projects
 Your Qualifications & Skills
 Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a closely related field
 Previous professional experience in a similar role
 Proven experience in high-voltage or medium-voltage power converter development
 Strong knowledge of multilevel converter topologies, particularly modular multilevel converters
 Hands-on experience with power electronics simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, LTspice, or equivalent
 Understanding of insulation, grounding, protection, and safety aspects in high-voltage systems
 Experience with digital control platforms such as microcontrollers or DSPs, with FPGA experience considered a strong plus
 Basic hands-on experience in building and testing power electronics hardware
 Passion for research and innovation, and a willingness to learn and adapt quickly
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus
 OUR COMMITMENT
 Innovative work environment in a young, dynamic team
 High-tech projects in the future-proof sector of e-mobility
 Opportunities for advancement in a growing company
 A wide range of further training opportunities
 Attractive bonus system and performance-related pay
 Additional company benefits 
 WHY ALPITRONIC
 Together with our customers, we are driving the world towards sustainable mobility – with cutting-edge technology, we inspire with the most innovative and reliable solutions. With our roots in South Tyrol, we are market and innovation leaders and set the future charging infrastructure standards from our locations in Bolzano/Bozen, Bergamo, Bologna, Munich and Charlotte (USA). 
 WHAT MAKES WORKING FOR US SPECIAL
 We are excited to meet individuals who are enthusiastic about making things happen, take personal responsibility and appreciate seeing the direct results of their work in the final product. We are a fast-growing company and offer our top teams a diverse and challenging range of tasks in a respectful corporate culture. Your contributions matter, are appreciated and have a significant impact! Join us and be part of our team!

Die Universität Rostock bietet Ihnen eine vielfältige, abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit in einer traditionsbewussten, aber dennoch innovativen, modernen und familienfreundlichen Hochschule in einer lebendigen Stadt am Meer. 
An der Fakultät für Informatik und Elektrotechnik, Institut für Elektrische Energietechnik, Lehrstuhl für Leistungselektronik besetzen wir vorbehaltlich der Mittelzuweisung zum 01.01.2027 befristet für die Dauer des Projektes Netzstabilität2035 bis 31.12.2027 die folgende Stelle:
**Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in (m/w/d) - Leistungselektronik | Universität Rostock | 3411**
Startdatum: zum 01.01.2027
Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden
Entgelt: Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L
Standort:Campus Südstadt
Ausschreibungsnummer: P 131/2026
Befristung: befristet bis 31.12.2027
Bewerbungsfrist: 20.11.2026
**DAS SIND IHRE AUFGABEN:**
• Bearbeiten des Projektthemas "Netzstabilisierung durch das Zusammenspiel aus Windenergie- und Elektrolyseanlagen"
• Erstellen von Simulationsmodellen in Matlab/Simulink/PLECS und PSCAD für Windenergieanlagen, Elektrolyseanlagen und elektrische Netze
• Erforschen von Regelungskonzepten
• Bewerten von Ergebnissen in Hinblick auf die einschlägigen Richtlinien zum Netzanschluss
• Erarbeiten von Vorschlägen zur Weiterentwicklung dieser Richtlinien
• Publizieren der Ergebnisse
**DAMIT PASSEN SIE ZU UNS:**
• abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Diplom, Master oder vergleichbarer Abschluss) in Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung mit mindestens gutem, möglichst sehr gutem Ergebnis
• vorzugsweise abgeschlossene Promotion auf dem Gebiet der Umrichterregelung
• sehr gute Kenntnisse der Leistungselektronik und der Regelungstechnik
• mehrjährige Erfahrung mit der Regelung von Umrichtern, vorzugsweise von Umrichtern am Netz für Batterien, Windenergieanlagen oder PV-Anlagen
• praktische Erfahrung mit der Code-Generierung von Matlab/Simulink auf Mikrocontroller
• sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie die Bereitschaft sich Deutschkenntnisse in kurzer Zeit anzueignen
**WIR ALS ARBEITGEBER:**
Chancengleichheit ist uns wichtig. Bewerbungen geeigneter schwerbehinderter oder gleichgestellter Menschen sind uns willkommen. Wir streben eine Erhöhung des Anteils von Frauen in Forschung und Lehre an und bestärken deshalb einschlägig qualifizierte Frauen sich zu bewerben. Bewerbungen von Menschen anderer Nationalitäten oder mit Migrationshintergrund begrüßen wir.

**WEITERE HINWEISE:**

Role Overview
 The Embedded Hardware Design Engineer will be responsible for the design, development, prototype bring-up, debugging and validation of embedded hardware for power electronic products.
 Key Responsibilities
 Design and develop power electronics hardware such as DC-DC converters, battery chargers, inverters, PFC and related control electronics.
 Design analog, digital and microcontroller-based circuits, including voltage/current sensing, protection and signal conditioning.
 Select and validate MOSFETs/IGBTs, gate drivers, inductors, capacitors and other critical components.
 Develop schematics and support PCB layout, design review and prototype manufacturing.
 Bring up prototype boards and perform hardware debugging using oscilloscope, DMM, electronic load, power supply and other laboratory equipment.
 Analyze switching waveforms, gate-drive signals, current/voltage feedback and power-stage performance.
 Debug hardware issues and identify the root cause of failures, including component, layout, noise and thermal-related problems.
 Work closely with embedded firmware engineers for PWM, ADC, CAN, protection and control implementation.
 Perform hardware validation for efficiency, thermal performance, protection functions and operating limits.
 Support EMI/EMC troubleshooting and design improvements.
 Prepare schematics, BOM, design documents and test reports.
 Support production issues, component qualification and engineering changes.
 Required Skills
 Good understanding of power electronics and switching converters.
 Hands-on experience with MOSFET/IGBT, gate drivers, current/voltage sensing and protection circuits.
 Experience with STM32, TI C2000 or similar microcontrollers.
 Good knowledge of ADC, PWM, CAN, SPI, I²C and UART.
 Experience with schematic and PCB design tools such as Altium, OrCAD or KiCad.
 Strong practical experience with oscilloscope and hardware debugging.
 Basic understanding of EMI/EMC, grounding, filtering and PCB layout practices.
 Ability to read datasheets and perform basic power-stage and component calculations.
 Preferred
 Experience in EV, automotive, battery, motor controller or high-power DC-DC applications.
 Experience with SiC/GaN devices, isolated power supplies or high-frequency converters.
 Exposure to LTspice, PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink or PSIM.
 Experience with hardware validation and production support.

items.jobTitle: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Starte deine Leadership Journey im Bereich R&D
items.jobDescription:
Bereit, die Zukunft der Technologie zu gestalten?  Wir suchen visionäre und technikbegeisterte Master-Graduates und PhDs mit Gestaltungswillen, die im Junior Managers Program die Zukunft der Mobilitäts- und Energiesysteme, die nächste Generation smarter, vernetzter Systeme oder die Welt der angewandten künstlichen Intelligenz neu erfinden. Du liebst technologische Herausforderungen, denkst strategisch und willst als zukünftige Führungskraft die digitale und physische Welt von Bosch verändern? Dann möchten wir von dir hören.​
 Über eine intensive Reise von 12–24 Monaten wirst du Teil unserer R&D-Organisation. Du rotierst durch verschiedene Bereiche in Deutschland und weltweit, sammelst wertvolle Auslandserfahrung und übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Arbeitspakete entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette.
 Du wirst nicht nur unterstützen – du wirst entwickeln, entscheiden und führen. Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Führungskräften und deinem persönlichen Mentor auf Managementebene legst du den Grundstein für deine Karriere im technologischen Führungsumfeld von Bosch.
 Was Du bei uns lernen und entwickeln wirst: ​ 
 Hardware & Systems Engineering :  Du tauchst tief in das internationale Entwicklungsnetzwerk für automobile Steuergeräte ein. Du begleitest die gesamte Hardware-Entwicklungskette: von Schaltungsdesign, Leistungselektronik und Halbleitern über Simulation, Verifikation und EMV-Prüfung bis hin zur Industrialisierung und dem Lifecycle-Management.​
 Software, IoT & Smart Systems: Du gestaltest die Zukunft smarter Thermotechnik- und Raumklimalösungen. Dabei arbeitest du an Zukunftstechnologien wie KI, IoT, Embedded Software, Data Science, Cloud-Architekturen oder entwickelst komplexe mechatronische Systemarchitekturen und Steuerungs-/Regelungssysteme.​
 Applied Artificial Intelligence & Robotics : Du treibst die Implementierung von künstlicher Intelligenz in realen Systemen voran. Du entwickelst KI-Agenten, wendest Data Science und Data Engineering im Engineering-Prozess an und bringst AI direkt in Embedded Systems und hochinnovative Produktentwicklungen ein.
 Führungskompetenz: Du lernst, wie man interdisziplinäre und internationale Teams koordiniert, Schnittstellen (zu Fertigung, Einkauf, Software und Kunden) steuert und komplexe technologische Projekte agil zum Erfolg führt.
Dein akademisches Fundament: Sehr gut abgeschlossenes Vollzeitmaster- oder Diplomstudium, idealerweise Promotion, im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Maschinenbau, Robotik, Mechatronik, Physik, Mathematik, Software- oder Chemie-/Verfahrens-/Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung mit entsprechenden fachlichen Schwerpunkten. 
 Deine Begeisterung für mechatronische und digitale Systeme: Dein Ziel ist es, die technische und kommerzielle Machbarkeit neuer Produktgenerationen zu bewerten und bis zur Serienreife zu führen – sei es bei innovativen Antriebs-, Thermo- und Wasserstofftechnologien, zukunftsweisenden IoT- und Raumklimalösungen oder bei der direkten Integration von Applied AI und KI-Agenten.
 Dein Blick für das große Ganze: Du findest es faszinierend, komplexe Zusammenhänge über Funktionsgrenzen hinweg zu analysieren, funktionale Schnittstellen (z. B. Entwicklung, Fertigung, Einkauf, Qualität, Kunden und Vertrieb) zu koordinieren und innovative Systemarchitekturen optimal auf die Anforderungen globaler Märkte auszurichten.
 Dein Verständnis für Human-centric Leadership: Du lebst die Überzeugung, dass herausragende Ergebnisse nur durch die Befähigung von Menschen entstehen. Mit emotionaler Intelligenz und Empathie schaffst du ein Umfeld, in dem interdisziplinäre und internationale Teams ihr volles Potenzial entfalten und gemeinsam erfolgreich sind.
 Du denkst strategisch und gestaltest die Zukunft: Du erkennst das große Ganze und leitest aus Marktanforderungen kritische technische KPIs sowie zukunftsweisende R&D-Roadmaps ab. Du besitzt starke Analysefähigkeiten und die Leidenschaft für "Hands-on"-Programmierung und Prompting, um innovative Konzepte (z. B. in Matlab, Python, C, Java oder mittels KI-Modellen) eigenständig zu erarbeiten und zu bewerten.
 Deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung: Du setzt in unserem dynamischen Umfeld deine Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen, täglich ein und entwickelst dich so kontinuierlich weiter – ein Growth-Mindset, das wir aktiv fördern.
 Deine sprachliche Gewandtheit: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Englisch und beherrschst die deutsche Sprache (oder bringst die Bereitschaft mit, diese schnell auszubauen), um dich in unserem internationalen und lokalen Umfeld sicher zu bewegen. Mindestens drei Monate Auslandserfahrung sowie eine hohe Mobilität runden dein Profil ab.
Warum du es lieben wirst, Teil unserer Community zu sein ​
Wir sind tief in das Wachstum unserer Teammitglieder investiert. Wir haben eine Umgebung geschaffen, in der du unterstützt, geschätzt und befähigt wirst, deine beste Arbeit zu leisten. ​
 ​
 Mentoring & Sponsoring:  Ein Mentor aus der Führungsebene begleitet dich auf deinem Weg, fördert aktiv deine Entwicklung und öffnet dir Türen für deine nächsten Karriereschritte bei uns.​
 Eine Kultur der Zugehörigkeit:  Vom ersten Tag an wirst du Teil einer globalen Community von Trainees aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und Standorten. Baue authentische Verbindungen über formale Projekte hinaus durch virtuelle Treffen, lokale Meetups oder unsere (globalen) Trainee-Gipfel. ​
 Flexibles & hybrides Arbeiten:  Wir vertrauen dir, deine Arbeit so zu managen, dass sie zu deinem Leben passt, mit einem flexiblen Startdatum und einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag. Wir bieten ein hybrides Modell, das Büro- und Remote-Zusammenarbeit kombiniert. ​
 Kontinuierliches Lernen:  Profitiere von 4-6 Rotationen in verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, einschließlich einer Rotation im Ausland mit einem großzügigen Budget für berufliche Entwicklung, einschließlich Kursen, Zertifizierungen und Konferenzen. ​
 Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft im Bereich R&D Mobilhydraulik​ zu gestalten? Bewirb dich jetzt und sag uns, warum du der perfekte Kandidat bist, um die digital Revolution zu leiten.
 Du hast Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess? 
Claudia Mertens-Baaij (Personalabteilung)
Telefon: 0711 811 7200

Ein telefonisches Interview, ein Assessment Center und ein finales Interview.

Job Description Summary
 Power Conversion treibt die elektrische Transformation der weltweiten Energieinfrastruktur voran. Wir entwickeln und liefern fortschrittliche Motor-, Antriebs- und Steuerungstechnologien, die die Effizienz und Dekarbonisierung von energieintensiven Prozessen und Systemen verbessern. Wir tragen dazu bei, die Energiewende in den Bereichen Marine, Energie und Industrie zu beschleunigen. Die Energieumwandlung ist das Herzstück der Elektrifizierung der Energie von morgen.
 Job Description
 Sie wollen in einem internationalen Konzernumfeld über sich selbst hinauswachsen? Sie zeichnen sich durch eine selbständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus? Sie wären gerne Teil eines globalen Unternehmens und legen Wert auf eine konstruktive Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Team. Dann werden Sie Teil unserer Organisation am Standort Berlin! Wir suchen Sie als Verstärkung unserer Organisation im Bereich Engineering als Entwicklungsingenieur Regelung elektrischer Antriebe (m/w/d).
Sie entwickeln SW für die Regelung und Steuerung von Stromrichtern und Elektroantrieben im Leistungsbereich von 100kW bis zu 100MW und mehr.
 Ihre Aufgaben
 Selbstständiger Entwurf, Entwicklung, Implementierung, Test und Dokumentation von SW für Stromrichter in Antriebsregelungen
 Systemintegration von Peripheriekomponenten sowie Entwicklung und Validierung von kundenspezifischen Lösungen
 Analyse von Schadensereignissen, deren Ursachenermittlung und Qualitätsverfolgung, inklusive der Ableitung von Lösungen
 Eigenverantwortliche Bewertung neuer Technologien und Management von Intellectual Property

 Ihr Profil

 Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Betriebsweise von verschiedenen Stromrichtern und Stromrichtertopologien, elektrischen Maschinen z.B. von Asynchronmaschine bzw. Synchronmaschinen oder Permanentmagnetmotoren
 Kenntnisse zum Betriebsverhalten und zur Regelung von Thyristorstromrichtern sowie zur Ansteuerung von Thyristoren erforderlich, idealerweise auch praktische Erfahrungen in diesem Bereich vorhanden
 Wahlweise auch gerne Erfahrungen im Bereich elektrischer Energieversorgungsnetze im Zusammenhang mit Stromrichterspeisung
 Vertrauter Umgang mit Tools zu Simulation und Rapid Prototyping von Stromrichtern und der Regelung mit Matlab/Simulink o.ä.

**Arbeiten bei uns - Raum für Ideen**
Wir bei NORD DRIVESYSTEMS entwickeln den richtigen Antrieb für weltweiten Fortschritt. Unsere innovativen Lösungen bringen z. B. Kräne in Hafenanlagen, Dachkonstruktionen in modernen Sportstadien, Gepäckförderbänder in Flughäfen und Gondelbahnen in Skigebieten in Bewegung. Unterstütze auch du uns mit deinen Ideen dabei, die Welt am Laufen zu halten.
** **Wir bewegen Zukunft****
Bei NORD DRIVESYSTEMS treibst Du im Bereich Forschung & Entwicklung neue Ideen und Technologien in der Antriebstechnik voran – von innovativen Motorkonzepten über zukunftsweisende Lösungen bis hin zu neuen Materialien und Oberflächen. Du beobachtest Trends, bewertest Technologien und entwickelst Konzepte für die Antriebstechnik von morgen. 
Dabei arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Wissenschaft, Konstruktion und Praxis und entwickelst Deine Ideen von ersten Lösungsansätzen bis zum einsatzfähigen Konzept weiter. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Entwicklung, Produktmanagement und Fertigung trägst Du dazu bei, die Energieeffizienz, Leistungsfähigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit unserer Antriebslösungen kontinuierlich zu steigern. 
Als Familienunternehmen setzen wir auf persönliche Zusammenarbeit, kurze Entscheidungswege und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
**Aufgaben**
- Unterstützung bei der mechanischen und elektromechanischen Konstruktion unseres mechatronischen Systems aus Frequenzumrichter, Motor und Peripherie – von der CAD-Entwicklung bis zur Verifikation im Versuch
- Entwicklung und Ausarbeitung von Kühlkonzepten sowie elektromechanischen Schnittstellen
- Erstellung und Pflege von 2D-Zeichnungen, 3D-Konstruktionen, Baugruppen, Ableitungen und Stücklisten mit Schwerpunkt auf Spritz- und Druckgussteilen
- Verifikation von Konstruktionen durch Plausibilitätsprüfungen, Toleranz- und Passungsanalysen, Reviews sowie technische Freigaben
- Auslegung, Durchführung und Auswertung thermischer Simulationen, beispielsweise zur Gehäuse- und Kühlkörperauslegung, Bewertung von Wärmewegen und Identifikation von Hot Spots
- Überprüfung und Optimierung von Kühlkonzepten im Versuch durch Versuchsplanung, Messungen und den Abgleich von Simulationsergebnissen mit Messdaten

items.jobDescription:
class="jobdescription">  
 Work environment 
 You will join a department with Group-wide lead responsibility for the development of high-voltage charging functions across the Volkswagen Group. High-voltage charging today involves far more than the interaction between a vehicle and a charging station. The vehicle, battery, backend systems, mobile applications, electricity tariffs, and charging infrastructure form a complex, interconnected ecosystem. For customers, however, charging should be simple, transparent, and reliable. This is where your doctoral research comes in: You will develop an intelligent, vehicle-based voice assistant for high-voltage charging that translates technical complexity into clear explanations and actionable recommendations. Why did my charging session stop? Why is my vehicle not achieving the expected charging performance? What conditions need to be met for optimal charging? And how can charging schedules be intelligently aligned with favorable electricity prices? Based on the current vehicle and charging context, the voice assistant should be able to answer questions such as these, explain technical dependencies and potential root causes in an understandable way, and provide customers with targeted recommendations for resolving charging-related issues. Building on an existing concept, your doctoral research will investigate how information from different systems can be integrated, interpreted, and processed in a context-aware manner to enable intuitive, dialogue-based interaction with the customer. The objective is to develop a future-ready assistance concept for intelligent and explainable high-voltage charging.
 Possible tasks within this role 
 Designing and further developing AI-based communication solutions for customer interaction related to charging issues and potential solutions for both BEVs and PHEVs
 Extending the functionality to determine charging costs at public charging stations, taking into account the interaction between Charge Point Operators (CPOs), Mobility Service Providers (MSPs), and the vehicle’s charging schedule
 Developing AI-based control and decision-making approaches for vehicle functions as part of your doctoral research
 Designing and evaluating the performance of AI-based methods, benchmarking them against competitive solutions and conventional algorithm-based approaches
 Implementing and validating the developed methods in prototypes using MATLAB, Python, or comparable development environments
 The final doctoral topic is defined together with the professor. The prerequisite for the cooperation is the confirmation of supervision as well as a confirmed delimitation of topics by the professor of a university or research institution entitled to confer a doctorate.
 Qualification requirements 
 Good to very good university degree qualifying for doctoral studies in electrical engineering, automotive engineering, information technology, or a comparable field 
 Experience working with system architecture models and requirements decomposition 
 Knowledge of ISO 15118 and ISO 26262, as well as the modeling languages SysML and UML 
 Experience in developing and working with neural networks, as well as proficiency in relevant programming languages, is desirable 
 German language level B1 
 Ability to understand and structure complex technical relationships, for example from use cases to software requirements 
 Knowledge of pedagogical or didactic principles relevant to the development of language models and human-machine interaction is desirable 
 The following documents must be submitted with the application 
 Curriculum Vitae
 Current transcript of records / Master’s or Diplom degree certificate
 Keywords 
 Dissertation, Charging, AI, KI, E-Mobility, LLM (Large Language Model), Volkswagen
 What we offer 
 Attractive salary & 30 vacation days (+ 24.12. and 31.12. off)
 35-hour week, flexible working hours, remote work
 Special conditions for the purchase and leasing of vehicles
 Free seminars on scientific work and interdisciplinary qualifications
 Participation in the doctoral network for scientific exchange with science representatives and other doctoral candidates within the Volkswagen Group

class="jobdescription">  
 Arbeitsumfeld 
 Sie erwartet ein Bereich, der die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung der Hochvolt-Ladefunktionen in leitender Funktion für den gesamten Volkswagen Konzern trägt. Hochvolt-Laden ist heute weit mehr als die Kommunikation zwischen Fahrzeug und Ladesäule. Fahrzeug, Batterie, Backend-Systeme, mobile Anwendungen, Stromtarife und Ladeinfrastruktur bilden ein komplexes Gesamtsystem. Für den Kunden hingegen sollte Laden möglichst einfach, verständlich und zuverlässig sein. Genau hier setzt Ihre Promotion an: Sie entwickeln einen intelligenten Sprachassistenten rund um das Hochvolt-Laden, der technische Komplexität in verständliche Informationen und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen übersetzt. Warum wurde mein Ladevorgang abgebrochen? Warum erreicht das Fahrzeug aktuell nicht die erwartete Ladeleistung? Welche Voraussetzungen müssen für einen optimalen Ladevorgang geschaffen werden? Und wie lassen sich Ladeplanung und günstige Strompreise sinnvoll miteinander verbinden? Der Sprachassistent soll solche Fragen auf Basis des aktuellen Fahrzeug- und Ladekontexts beantworten, technische Zusammenhänge und Ursachen verständlich erklären und den Kunden mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen bei der Lösungsfindung unterstützen. Aufbauend auf einem bestehenden Konzept erforschen Sie im Rahmen Ihrer Promotion, wie Informationen aus unterschiedlichen Systemen zusammengeführt, interpretiert und kontextbezogen aufbereitet werden können, um sie für eine dialogbasierte Kundeninteraktion nutzbar zu machen. Ziel ist die Entwicklung eines zukunftsfähigen Assistenzkonzepts für intelligentes und erklärbares Hochvolt-Laden. 
 Mögliche Aufgaben dieser Rolle 
 Konzipieren und Weiterentwickeln von KI-basierten Kommunikationslösungen für eine Kundeninteraktion zu Ladeproblemen und möglichen Lösungen, für BEV- und PHEV-Fahrzeuge
 Erweitern der Funktionalität auf Kostenermittlung von öffentlichen Ladestationen in Kombination von CPO (Charge Point Operator), MSP (Mobility Service Provider) und Ladeplan
 Entwickeln von KI‑basierten Steuerungs‑ und Entscheidungslogiken für Fahrzeugfunktionen im Rahmen einer Promotion
 Entwerfen und Bewerten der Leistungsfähigkeit KI‑gestützter Verfahren im Vergleich zu Wettbewerbern und algorithmusbasierten Ansätzen
 Prototypisches Umsetzen und Validieren entwickelter Methoden in MATLAB, Python oder vergleichbaren Entwicklungsumgebungen
 Das endgültige Promotionsthema wird mit der Professorin / dem Professor gemeinsam definiert. Die Voraussetzung für die Zusammenarbeit ist die Betreuungszusage sowie eine bestätigte Themenabgrenzung seitens der Professorin/des Professors einer promotionsberechtigten Universität oder Forschungseinrichtung.
 Anforderungen an die Qualifikation

 Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Systemarchitekturmodellen und Dekomposition von Anforderungen
 Kenntnisse der Normen ISO 15118 und ISO 26262 sowie der Modellierungssprachen SysML und UML
 Erfahrungen mit einem eigens entwickelten neuronalen Netz sowie einschlägigen Programmiersprachen sind wünschenswert
 Deutsch Sprachniveau B1
 Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen Zusammenhängen, z.B. vom Use Case zur Software-Anforderung
 Pädagogische Vorkenntnisse zur Entwicklung eines Sprachmodells sind wünschenswert
 Folgende Dokumente sind mit der Bewerbung einzureichen 
 Lebenslauf
 Aktueller Notenspiegel / Master- oder Diplomzeugnis

Do you love technological challenges, think strategically, and want to lead as a future manager in Bosch's digital and physical worlds? Then we want to hear from you.​
 Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will become part of our global R&D organization. You will rotate through different areas in Germany and worldwide, gain valuable international experience, and take on responsibility for high-impact work packages from day one. Depending on your business unit and focus, you will either design the hardware value chain for automotive control units or drive groundbreaking software, IoT, and system developments for smart homes.
 You won't just support—you will develop, decide, and lead. Together with experienced executives and your personal mentor on management level, you will lay the foundation for your career in Bosch’s technological leadership environment.
 What you will learn and develop with us:​ 
 Hardware & Systems Engineering:  You will dive deep into the development, industrialization, and commercialization of powertrain and energy solutions – ranging from efficient combustion-engine systems and high-performance thermal management to hydrogen technologies (fuel cells, electrolysis stacks) as well as electronics, software, controls, and components sales. 
 Software, IoT & Smart Systems:  You will shape the future of smart thermal technology and room climate solutions. You will work on future technologies like IoT, embedded software, data science, cloud architectures, or develop complex mechatronic system architectures and control systems. 
 Applied Artificial Intelligence & Robotics: You will drive the implementation of artificial intelligence into real-world applications. You will design AI agents, utilize data science and data engineering within engineering/product development, and bring hands-on AI capabilities into embedded systems.
 You will learn how to coordinate interdisciplinary and international teams, manage interfaces (with manufacturing, purchasing, software, and customers), and successfully lead complex technological projects in an agile way.
Your academic foundation: An outstanding full-time Master's degree or Diploma, ideally a PhD, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Physics, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Chemical/Process/Energy Engineering, or a comparable technical field of study with appropriate academic priorities
 Your passion for mechatronic and digital systems: Your goal is to evaluate the technical and commercial feasibility of new product generations and lead them all the way to series production readiness—whether in innovative powertrain, thermal, and hydrogen technologies, connected IoT and room climate solutions, or in integrating applied AI and AI agents directly into embedded systems.
 Your eye for the bigger picture: You find it fascinating to analyze complex relationships across functional boundaries, coordinate functional interfaces (e.g., development, manufacturing, purchasing, quality, customers, and sales), and optimally align innovative system architectures with the requirements of global markets.
 Your understanding of human-centric leadership: You live by the conviction that outstanding results only emerge by empowering people. Utilizing emotional intelligence and empathy, you foster an environment where interdisciplinary and international teams unlock their full potential and succeed together.
 You think strategically and shape the future: You recognize the big picture and derive critical technical KPIs as well as forward-looking R&D roadmaps from market requirements. You bring strong analytical skills and a passion for hands-on programming and prompting to develop and evaluate innovative solution concepts (e.g., in Matlab, Python, C, Java, or utilizing AI models).
 Your continuous development:  In our dynamic environment, you leverage your ability to learn quickly every day, continuously developing yourself—a growth mindset that we actively support and nurture.
 Your language proficiency: You communicate fluently in English (negotiation level) and possess a strong command of the German language (or have the drive to develop it quickly) to navigate confidently within both our international and local environments. At least three months of international experience and high mobility round off your profile.
Why you will love being part of our community 
 We are deeply invested in the growth of our team members. We have created an environment where you are supported, valued, and empowered to do your best work.
 Mentoring & Sponsoring:  An executive-level mentor will accompany you on your journey, actively support your development, and open doors for your next career steps with us.
 A culture of belonging:  From day one, you will become part of a global community of trainees from diverse backgrounds and locations. Build authentic connections beyond formal projects through virtual hangouts, local meetups, or our (global) trainee summits.
 Flexible & hybrid working:  We trust you to manage your work in a way that fits your life, with a flexible start date and a permanent employment contract. We offer a hybrid model that combines office and remote collaboration.
 Continuous learning:  Benefit from up to 6 rotations across different departments, including an international rotation, supported by a generous budget for your professional development (courses, certifications, and conferences).

TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Researcher to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.
 About Davis 
 Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.
 We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.
 We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.
 The Role 
 You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.
 You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.
 What you will be working on 
 Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.
 Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.
 Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.
 Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.
 Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.
 Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.
 What We Are Looking For 
 You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.
 Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.
 Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.
 Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.
 Nice to have 
 Computer vision and document understanding , images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.
 Graph and structured scientific data , molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.
 Synthetic worlds and simulation , a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.
 Foundation models from scratch , real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.
 Public evidence of data ownership , lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.
 GIS and geometry , parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.
 Multi-country data , heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.
 Why Join Davis 
 Own the data end to end , from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.
 Shape a foundation model from scratch , on a structured representation no one else is training on.
 Work on genuinely hard problems , image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.
 Competitive salary and meaningful equity , at a founding level, in an early-stage company.
 Join a world-class team , a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.
 More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after: 
 Team 
 Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.
 Today we are a team of twelve : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.
 Why We Will Win 
 Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.
 Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work , AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.
 Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design 
 Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability , and parametric tools only check constraints after generation , which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.
 Generative AI has the potential to solve this , but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.
 This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.
 We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. 
 If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

Contexte
 Dans le cadre du développement des plateformes électriques Renault Group, le service Électronique de Puissance conçoit et développe des systèmes de conversion d'énergie destinés aux véhicules électriques, notamment les convertisseurs DC/DC, les chargeurs embarqués (OBC) et les onduleurs (Inverters).
Afin de renforcer nos équipes, nous recrutons un(e) Architecte Contrôle DC/DC / OBC / Onduleur, en charge de la conception et du développement des architectures de contrôle-commande et des stratégies de régulation associées à ces différents systèmes d'électronique de puissance.
Ce poste requiert une expertise approfondie en contrôle-commande, une bonne compréhension des systèmes d'électronique de puissance et une forte capacité à intervenir sur des problématiques techniques complexes de modélisation, simulation et validation.
 Vos missions
 Définir et concevoir les architectures de contrôle-commande des systèmes de conversion d'énergie (DC/DC, OBC, onduleurs), en tenant compte des spécificités de chaque typologie de convertisseur.
 Développer et optimiser les lois de commande et les algorithmes de régulation de tension et de courant, afin de garantir la performance, la stabilité et la robustesse des systèmes.
 Concevoir les stratégies de contrôle associées aux différents modes de fonctionnement (démarrage, arrêt, modes dégradés, gestion des défauts et protections).
 Modéliser le comportement des systèmes d'électronique de puissance, notamment les différentes topologies de convertisseurs isolés et non isolés, ainsi que leurs interactions avec les stratégies de contrôle.
 Réaliser des activités avancées de modélisation, de simulation et d'émulation afin d'évaluer, de valider et d'optimiser les performances des architectures de contrôle-commande.
 Développer et valider les modèles de contrôle sous MATLAB / Simulink, notamment à travers des environnements de simulation MIL, SIL et HIL.
 Assurer la cohérence entre les architectures de contrôle logiciel et les contraintes hardware des systèmes d'électronique de puissance.
 Participer aux phases d'intégration, d'essais sur banc et de validation des stratégies de contrôle.
 Contribuer à l'intégration des exigences de sûreté de fonctionnement, de diagnostic et de robustesse dans les stratégies de contrôle.
 Collaborer avec les équipes d'électronique de puissance, de conception hardware, de développement software embarqué, de système et de validation.
 Votre profil
 Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation universitaire équivalente, avec une spécialisation en électronique de puissance, automatique, contrôle-commande ou génie électrique. Un doctorat dans l'un de ces domaines serait un plus.

About hyperexponential (hx) 
 At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. Job Description 
 ATMOS Works is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer – Payload Integration (m/f/d) to develop the onboard software that connects our customers' payloads to the Phoenix capsule, from microcontroller firmware and embedded Linux to the communication interfaces between payloads and our avionics. As our system and the payloads we fly keep evolving, you will help shape the architecture and adapt it to new requirements. Working closely with customers, hardware engineers, and the AIT team, you will take payloads from the first interface definition through testing all the way to flight.
 Key Responsibilities 
 You will design, implement, and test embedded software for onboard computers and payload interface units, bare-metal or RTOS-based, for example on STM32 microcontrollers.
 You will develop embedded Linux software on compute modules such as the Raspberry Pi CM4.
 You will integrate customer payloads into the Phoenix avionics over interfaces such as CAN, RS232, RS422, RS485, USB, and Ethernet.
 You will define and maintain Interface Control Documents together with payload customers, and translate their requirements into software.
 You will build simulation and test environments, including software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop setups, automate tests, and support payload integration and debugging at the hardware and software boundary.
 You will contribute to the evolution of the avionics and payload software architecture with a focus on robustness and fault tolerance, and document the software in line with project and quality requirements.
 Requirements 
 Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or a comparable field, or equivalent practical experience.
 3+ years of professional experience in embedded software development.
 Excellent C skills and good knowledge of C++.
 Hands-on experience with microcontrollers such as ARM Cortex-M and STM32 and their peripherals, and with real-time operating systems such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr.
 Solid understanding of common serial and bus interfaces such as CAN, UART, RS232, RS422, RS485, SPI, I2C, and Ethernet.
 Experience with software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop testing, and confident use of lab equipment such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
 An independent, hands-on working style and the ability to work with changing requirements.
 Very good written and spoken English; German is a plus.
 Please note that we can only consider applicants for this position who are nationals of an EU member state.* 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with embedded Linux, for example Yocto, Buildroot, device trees, and drivers.
 Experience with ROS or ROS 2.
 Background in space or another safety-critical industry such as automotive, aviation, or medical, and familiarity with the related standards.
 Knowledge of space protocols and concepts such as CCSDS, SpaceWire, or FDIR.
 Python skills for test automation and tooling.
 ATMOS Works is a dedicated business unit of ATMOS Space Cargo, based in Kraków, with a business unit in Lichtenau, established to serve European government and defence customers. ATMOS Works develops and operates dual-use orbital capabilities, including the secure, sovereign return of sensitive hardware and data, in-orbit demonstration and validation (IOD/IOV), and advanced space systems.
 Company description 
 ATMOS was founded as a European company built on the values of freedom, democracy, equality, the rule of law, and human rights. We are committed to protect these values by making our technology available to others who share the same values, strengthening infrastructure and innovation for prosperity on Earth.
 Our team is multinational and diverse, with offices in Lichtenau and Strasbourg. We work in a collegial, hands-on culture where people support each other, take ownership, and keep learning every day. Motivation for the mission comes first — building spacecraft is not a nine-to-five pursuit. We align the mission, the team, and the individual in mutual dependence. This principle shapes our work environment where exceptional people, as committed as they are competent, can grow and contribute to a mission that matters.

### Standort Villingen-Schwenningen / Tuningen
Die Module sind auf dem Dach. Jetzt müssen Wechselrichter, Speicher und Elektrik sauber installiert und die Anlage in Betrieb genommen werden. Mehrere Teams sind unterwegs, Termine ändern sich und technische Fragen brauchen schnelle Antworten.

## ☀️ Wer ist MySolar Express?
Wir beraten, planen und installieren Photovoltaikanlagen, Stromspeicher und Wallboxen in ganz Deutschland. **Über 6.000 Anlagen** haben wir bereits verbaut. In unserer gesamten Firmengruppe arbeiten **mehr als 250 Menschen**.

Du koordinierst unsere AC- und Elektromontagen – von der Einsatzplanung über die Installation bis zur vollständigen Dokumentation und Inbetriebnahme.
- 📅 Du disponierst Elektriker und AC-Montageteams.

- 🤝 Du stimmst Termine und Änderungen mit Kunden und internen Abteilungen ab.

- 📸 Du kontrollierst den Baustellenfortschritt aus der Ferne anhand von Fotos, Checklisten und Montagedokumentation.
- 🔄 Du verfolgst offene Punkte, technische Rückfragen und Nacharbeiten bis zum Abschluss.
- ⚡ Du stimmst dich mit DC-Montage, Planung, Elektromeistern, Anmeldung und Service ab.

- **Erfahrung im elektrischen Bereich – das ist Voraussetzung.**

Job Description Summary
 At GE HealthCare, we are advancing precision health through innovative technologies. We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer with a strong focus on embedded systems to join our Pharmaceutical Diagnostics team supporting PET Products.
In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for our FASTlab and TRACERlab platforms, as well as contribute to the PC-based control software that operates these systems. You will work across the entire software development lifecycle, helping to deliver high-quality, reliable solutions in a regulated medical environment that directly impacts patient care. Our team embraces modern, AI-assisted development workflows using tools such as Claude and Codex.
This is a hybrid role based in Münster, Germany, with an expectation to work at least 3 days per week in the office to foster collaboration and innovation within the team. In addition, hands-on work with our FASTlab and TRACERlab systems in the lab is an essential part of this role.
At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch.
 Job Description
 Key Responsibilities
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define system requirements and contribute to software architecture and design.
 Translate requirements into robust, maintainable embedded firmware solutions (C-based) including testing and detailed documentation.
 Design, implement, and validate new features for both embedded systems and PC applications, ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards.
 Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude or Codex as part of our software development workflow while critically reviewing all AI-generated results to ensure they meet our quality and regulatory requirements.
 Execute and support verification and validation (V&V) activities to demonstrate product safety, performance, and reliability.
 Partner with service teams, customers, and hardware suppliers to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues in embedded control systems, performing root-cause analysis across hardware, firmware, and software components.
 Apply Design for Reliability (DfR) principles and leverage Agile and Lean methodologies to drive continuous improvement.
 Work with global engineering teams to ensure consistency and reuse across software platforms.
 Collaborate with external hardware partners to ensure seamless hardware/software integration.
 Required Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
 Significant experience developing embedded software in C for microcontroller-based systems
 Exposure to Windows-based application development (C#/.NET preferred) and willingness to contribute when required
 Strong understanding of embedded software architecture and design
 Understanding of embedded electronics, including ADC/DAC, digital I/O, interrupts, PWM, motor control, and PID control systems
 Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, serial interfaces, and hardware diagnostic tools
 Familiarity with software configuration management and version control tools (e.g., Git, Azure DevOps)
 Practical experience in using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot) for software development, including the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated code
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Good English skills are essential, as English is our primary working language; good German skills (B2 or higher) are also required
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience working in regulated industries (e.g., medical devices, automotive, or similar)
 Knowledge of medical device software standards such as IEC 62304 and ISO 13485
 Experience with unit testing for embedded C and CI/CD pipelines.
 Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS)
 Knowledge of communication protocols and interfaces such as RS232, CAN, Ethernet, and TCP/IP
 Familiarity with PIC32 microcontrollers and the IDE MPLAB.
 Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and component datasheets

 The Energy Company is an advanced battery and energy storage solutions provider
 specializing in the design and manufacture of intelligent Battery Packs and Energy Storage
 Systems (ESS).

 commercial, industrial, and renewable energy storage applications.

 development to design and develop firmware for Battery Management Systems (BMS) and

 microcontrollers, communication protocols, and hardware-software integration. Experience in

 In order to support our Flight Test Installation (FTI) Engineering team, Airbus Operations is looking for a
 Processes, Methods & Tools (PMT) Focal for Flight Test Installation (FTI) (d/f/m)  
 Are you looking for a combination of innovative technical challenges and a communication focus with transnational internal stakeholders? Then this is the right place for you! The future of aviation does not happen by chance, but through precision, smart methods, and state-of-the-art engineering infrastructure. As one of the world’s leading players in the aerospace industry, we develop next-generation aircraft and systems – more efficiently, safely, and sustainably.
 Behind every pioneering innovation lies a well-thought-out process landscape. In this key role, you will operate directly in an environment at the interface between systems engineering, software and hardware development, and IT. You will optimize the tools and working methods of our design teams, eliminate friction losses in the development cycle, and ensure that product configurations remain seamlessly traceable throughout their entire lifecycle.
 This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
 Our Benefits for You

 Strong communication skills, diplomatic acumen at cross-functional interfaces, and a structured, solution-oriented, and proactive way of working.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.
 Description

Key Responsibilities
 As a Propulsion Functional Engineer, Your Responsibilities Will Include
 Functional Engineering
 Contribute to architecture trade-off studies, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments, as well as component selection and make-or-buy decisions
 Contribute to the evaluation and optimization of the engine architecture and operating conditions
 Develop and maintain functional performance models of the propulsion system using simulation frameworks such as EcosimPro and Python
 Systems Engineering

 Testing & Model Validation

 What we would love to see from you
 Master's Degree or higher (or NZ and AUS "Bachelor with honors") in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related and applicable technical discipline. Alternatively, a bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience
 Minimum 2 years of proven experience working with cryogenic propulsion systems
 Strong knowledge of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics
 Fluency in English; proficiency in German or French are an asset
 Basic knowledge of aerospace standards (e.g. ECSS, NASA guidelines)
 Experience with modelling and simulation tools (e.g. EcosimPro) and/or experience writing scripts in Python
 (Optional) Hands-on experience developing hardware from concept to working prototypes is an asset
 Skills And Behaviors
 Strong ability to work in close collaboration with others
 Strong oral and written communication skills
 Strong analysis and problem-solving skills
 Strong research skills and ability to infer useful information from partial or even contradictory sources
 Drive towards excellence coupled with ability to work within time constraints
 Proficiency in organization and prioritization of tasks
 Behavior consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork
 Enthusiasm for space exploration: be ready to have an impact on the future global space industry.

 We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind

coneva entwickelt datengetriebene Softwarelösungen zur Reduktion von Stromkosten für Industrie- und Gewerbekunden. Ein intelligentes Energiemanagementsystem steuert stationäre Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge so, dass Eigenverbrauch optimiert, Netzkosten reduziert und verbleibende Strommengen effizient an Spotmärkten vermarktet werden.
 Als Teil der PARI Group verbindet coneva technologische Innovationskraft mit einem stabilen, langfristig orientierten Unternehmensumfeld.
 Ziel der Rolle
 Unsere Software ist nur so gut wie ihre Verbindung zur realen Anlagenwelt. Genau dort setzt diese Rolle an: Du verantwortest die Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Energiemanagementsystem und der Hardware beim Kunden – Batteriespeicher, Ladeinfrastruktur, Datenlogger, EZA-Regler, Messtechnik und perspektivisch weitere Devices wie bspw. Wärmepumpen.
 Die Rolle vereint zwei Perspektiven:
 Produktseitig verantwortest du als Product Owner die Weiterentwicklung unserer Edge- und Integrationsprodukte, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem Embedded-Engineering und steuerst die technischen Partnerschaften zu Hardwareherstellern.
 Projektseitig bist du als Solution Engineer die technische Instanz im Vertriebs- und Umsetzungsprozess: Du entwickelst Systemschaubilder und kundenspezifische Lösungsarchitekturen, unterstützt Sales technisch – und überführst wiederkehrende Muster aus dem Projektgeschäft zurück in ein standardisiertes Produkt.
 Damit sitzt du an einer der zentralen Stellen im Unternehmen: Du entscheidest mit, welche Anlagenwelt wir morgen abdecken und wie schnell wir neue Kundenanforderungen umsetzen können.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Product Owner – Edge, Geräteintegration & Hardwarepartner 
 Verantwortung für Roadmap, Backlog und Priorisierung unserer Edge-Devices (z. B. SmartBox) und der Geräteanbindungen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering

items.jobTitle: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Start your Leadership Journey in Corporate Research
items.jobDescription:
Ready to push the boundaries of what is known today?  We are looking for visionary pioneers with a PhD and an absolute drive to invent the technological future of Bosch in our Junior Managers Program. If you have a deep passion for fundamental research, think strategically, and want to shape the future as a leader in corporate research, we want to hear from you. ​
 Over an intensive journey of up to 18 months, you will rotate through the key areas of our global research and development organization. Your mission: as a catalyst, identify and develop new technologies and business opportunities that secure Bosch's long-term innovative strength and competitiveness.​
 You will lead highly innovative projects from concept to prototype, receive guidance from leading researchers and top executives, and gain practical experience with technologies that will shape our world of tomorrow.​
 What you will learn and develop with us: ​ 
 You will learn how strategic research works within a global technology group—spanning areas like AI, quantum computing, or semiconductor technology—from trend analysis and patent development to transferring technologies into our business sectors. ​
 As a pioneer, you will shape the foundation for Bosch's future core technologies, whether it is the next generation of AI systems or the development of novel cloud architectures.​
 You will collaborate with top international researchers in our global research centers to solve the technological challenges of the future, working alongside your personal top-management mentor to purposefully prepare you for your future role as a leader at Bosch.​
 Your academic foundation: 
 An  excellent PhD  in one of the following fields: Information/Cyber Security, System Design/Cloud Architecture, Data Management, Software/Quantum Computing, AI/Data Science, Machine Learning/Deep Learning, Distributed Systems, Power Electronics, or Semiconductors.
Your passion for the world of research: 
You are naturally curious, think beyond the obvious, and are passionate about solving complex technological challenges. You have already gathered initial industry experience, e.g., through relevant internships.​
 Your eye for the bigger picture: 
You find it fascinating how scientific insights transform into disruptive innovations for a global enterprise, and you are motivated to link your research findings with Bosch's strategic goals.​
 Your understanding of human-centric leadership: 
You live by the conviction that breakthrough research is created in teams. Utilizing emotional intelligence and empathy, you foster a creative environment where you inspire others with your ideas and achieve outstanding results together.​
 You think strategically and shape the future: 
You identify technology trends early on, derive a clear vision for new research areas as a leader, and develop the roadmap that takes us there. You possess profound knowledge of relevant programming languages and tools such as Java, C++, Python, Matlab, MLOps, or cloud systems.​
 Your continuous development: 
You view research as a continuous learning process and bring a growth mindset to constantly develop yourself and your topics in a highly dynamic environment.​
 Your language proficiency: 
You communicate fluently in English (negotiation level) and possess good German language skills to navigate confidently within our local and international research environments.​
Why you will love being part of our community 
 We are deeply invested in the growth of our team members. We have created an environment where you are supported, valued, and empowered to do your best work.
 Mentoring & Sponsoring:  An executive-level mentor will accompany you on your journey, actively support your development, and open doors for your next career steps with us.
 A culture of belonging:  From day one, you will become part of a global community of trainees from diverse backgrounds and locations. Build authentic connections beyond formal projects through virtual hangouts, local meetups, or our (global) trainee summits.
 Flexible & hybrid working:  We trust you to manage your work in a way that fits your life, with a flexible start date and a permanent employment contract. We offer a hybrid model that combines office and remote collaboration.
 Continuous learning:  Benefit from up to 6 rotations across different departments, including an international rotation, supported by a generous budget for your professional development (courses, certifications, and conferences).
 Are you ready to shape the future of Corporate Research with us? Apply now and tell us why you are the perfect candidate to lead the digital revolution.
 Do you have questions about the application process? 
Claudia Mertens-Baaij (Human Resources)
Telephone: 0711 811 7200
 Our application process for the Junior Managers Program includes multiple steps:
a Telephone Interview, Assessment Center and a Final Interview.
 As a globally active company, we are legally required to comply with applicable EU and US (re)export control and sanctions regulations. Therefore, we will ask you to provide further information at a later step in the recruiting process. For details on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Data Protection Notice .

items.jobTitle: Control Systems and Embedded Engineer (m / f / d)
items.jobDescription:
Munich and Garching · full-time (32h – 40h / week negotiable) · permanent · starting as soon as possible · reporting directly to the management 
 CollimateHealth is a TUM spin-off at the intersection of physics, engineering and health. We develop the world’s first clinically scalable microbeam radiation technology designed to reshape the way cancer is treated. Until now, microbeams could only be produced at large synchrotrons; with our compact source, we reduced the space needed to less than 10 m². Now, we are building the first clinical devices and we need you to be part of our team. 
 Our core technology is a patented line-focus x-ray tube with special electron beam focusing, a rotating target, an ultra-high vacuum system, and a powerful cooling. The x-ray beam is shaped into microbeams by a multi-slit collimator, which is housed in the beam applicator together with safety equipment. Commissioning, operation, and preclinical testing will be performed by our in-house control system from early 2027. 
 As our control systems and hardware engineer, you take over and own our in-house control system – first for our prototype in Garching, then for our first clinical device in Munich. 
 What you bring: 
 University degree in electrical engineering, physics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience. 
 Good Python programming skills, including threading. 
 Experience in programming software that remotely controls lab equipment (e.g. via SCPI, Modbus, serial or Ethernet).
 Good Linux and network skills (e.g. DHCP, static IP addressing, switches, converters).
 Drive, a hands-on “just try it” mentality, and the will to take responsibility.
 Excellent communication skills in an interdisciplinary team. 
 Proficiency in written and spoken English (German is a plus).
 Nice to have: 
 PLC programming or automation engineering. 
 Experience with high voltage, vacuum technology, or machine safety and interlocks.
 Knowledge of radiation protection or clinical radiation therapy.
 Experience with medical device standards (ISO 13485, IEC 62304, IEC 60601), technical documentation for medical devices, and work in a regulated environment. 
 What you do: 
 You own the control system. You take over our in-house machine control system (Linux, Python) for our prototype for technical testing and preclinical experiments. The server is practically finished, the client is a first version, and the architecture is documented. 
  You integrate the hardware. With our team, you connect the safety system (Modbus), the frequency convertor for the target motor, the power supplies (high voltage system, cathode, electron beam magnets), patient positioning and robot arm, sensors (vacuum, target speed and vibration, cooling temperature and flow), and cameras (piCams). Interfaces: Ethernet and serial; protocols: SCPI, Modbus, TCP/IP.
 High-voltage conditioning. You re-implement the automatic conditioning as part of the new control system.
  Commission and test. You do cabling, commissioning, and troubleshooting in our radiation and high-voltage lab and support technical tests and preclinical experiments.
 Own the network. You check, repair, and maintain our lab network (Linux, DHCP, static IPs).
 You coordinate the development of the control and safety system for our clinical prototype together with a partner company (machine control system and the treatment control system). You closely follow their development to become our in-house expert, so we can maintain and adapt it ourselves. 
 Focal spot monitoring. You develop the monitoring of position, size, and shape of the electron beam focal spot on the target, necessary for safe microbeam irradiations. 
 What we offer: 
 A fascinating technology – a real moonshot in engineering, physics and health sciences – ownership of the control system of a medical device from its early days, with a documented system to start from.
 A team full of talented, down-to-earth physicists and engineers from all over the world. A workplace, where you can own your stuff and get things done. A workplace where everyone is passionate about making an impact on the future of cancer therapies. 
 We provide clear career prospects, a dynamic, growing environment, the opportunity to actively shape things, and team events to celebrate our successes. 
 Flexible working hours, hybrid work, 30 days’ vacation and an individual training budget. 
 Working in one of the world’s most livable cities; we are easily reachable and have a vibrant location in the Werksviertel close to Ostbahnhof, plus our prototype lab in Garching.
 Please send your CV and a short motivation letter to Hans Maria Heÿn: info@collimatehealth.com 
 Data Protection 
 We process your personal data for the purpose of managing the recruitment process and assessing your application. For detailed information on how your data is processed, including your rights, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

Graduate Engineer – Robotics, Automation & Maintenance (m/f/d) 
 Start your career at JINGDONG Logistics 
 Your degree is nearly finished. Ready to see your knowledge in motion? 
 Join JINGDONG Logistics and take your first career step in automated warehouse logistics. Work with robotics, conveyor technology, and industrial control systems—and help keep hundreds of autonomous guided vehicles (AGVs) operating safely and reliably.
 This entry-level opportunity is aimed at final-year students and recent graduates seeking a practical, hands-on engineering role .
 Your role 
 As part of our technical team, you will support the maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvement of equipment used in our logistics operations. You will apply your engineering knowledge to real technical challenges and build practical experience across mechanical, electrical, and automated systems.
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Supporting preventive maintenance and inspections of automated equipment.
 Investigating faults and assisting with repairs to mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems.
 Helping maintain the reliable operation of warehouse robots and conveyor systems.
 Assisting with equipment installation, testing, and commissioning.
 Using technical drawings, electrical schematics, and diagnostic tools.
 Documenting maintenance work and identifying opportunities to improve equipment performance.
 Following safety procedures and working closely with technical and operations colleagues.
 Your profile 
 You are in the final stages of, or have recently completed, a degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Robotics, or a related discipline .
 You enjoy practical engineering and want to work directly with machinery and automated systems.
 You bring technical foundations from university projects, laboratory work, internships, or personal projects.
 You approach problems systematically and work carefully, independently, and collaboratively.
 Initial knowledge of PLCs, industrial automation, or electrical schematics is welcome.
 You are willing to work in an operational warehouse environment, including shifts and weekend work where required.
 Previous full-time professional experience is not required. 
 What you can look forward to 
 Robotics at scale: A modern warehouse logistics environment with hundreds of AGVs operating simultaneously.
 Practical engineering experience: Direct exposure to robotics, conveyor technology, and industrial equipment.
 Varied technical challenges: Opportunities to develop your maintenance, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills.
 Visible impact: Your contribution helps keep daily logistics operations moving.
 An international team: Collaboration with colleagues from different technical and cultural backgrounds.
 Room to contribute: Opportunities to suggest improvements to equipment reliability and maintenance processes.
 Apply and put your engineering knowledge to work. 
 Please submit your CV, expected graduation date, and earliest possible start date . Feel free to include relevant university projects, internships, or practical technical experience.
 JINGDONG Logistics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.
